findFreeVoice.failure: returns -1 when no free slot exists and the priority-steal gate is not satisfied
findFreeVoice.freeSlot: returns the first selected-pool index whose g_snd.voiceAliasHash slot is zero
findFreeVoice.fullPool: Snd_GetLowestPriority returns the lowest globalPriority and its channel over that pool

poolSelection.SA_LOADED: voice indices begin at 10; count = Dvar_GetInt(snd_max_ram_voice)
poolSelection.allOtherLoadTypeValues: voice indices begin at 0; count = Dvar_GetInt(snd_max_stream_voice)

findFreeVoice.stealAction: SND_StopVoice(candidate); exact code asserts the candidate voiceAliasHash slot became zero; return candidate channel
findFreeVoice.stealRule: steal only when incomingPriority > lowestExistingGlobalPriority + Dvar_GetFloat(snd_playing_priority_boost)

callBindingFromSND_PlaySoundAlias: general limit: aliasId(+0x04), limitCount(+0x5D), flags0.limitType(bits25-26), useEnt=false, computed global priority
entity limit: aliasId(+0x04), entityLimitCount(+0x5E), flags0.entityLimitType(bits27-28), useEnt=true, same SndEntHandle, computed global priority
generalAndEntityLimits.playingInfo: SND_GetPlayingInfo(aliasHash,&count,&oldest,&least,&isMultiple,ent,useEnt) scans active matching alias hashes; when useEnt is true it applies the exact entity predicate. `oldest` is selected by the minimum exact voice +0x24 integer; `least` is selected by the minimum exact voice globalPriority at +0xE4.

rules.NONE: allow immediately; no playing-info census or eviction
rules.OLDEST: at/over limit stops the returned oldest channel when nonnegative, then allows; if no oldest channel is returned, allows
rules.PRIORITY: at/over limit requires a nonnegative least-priority channel and incomingPriority > existing.globalPriority + snd_playing_priority_boost; on success stops that channel and allows, otherwise rejects
rules.commonPreGate: after SND_GetPlayingInfo, isMultiple==true rejects; count < limitCount allows

voiceLimitAndVolumeGroup.unnamedGlobal: The PDB/source member name for g_snd+0x158 is intentionally not assigned here; only its exact address/offset and comparison behavior are promoted.
voiceLimitAndVolumeGroup.voiceLimit: If incoming alias flags0.voiceLimit bit9 is set, SND_LimitVoice scans all 68 active voices with the same SndEntHandle; any existing alias whose voiceLimit bit9 is also set is stopped via SND_StopVoice before the new attempt continues.
voiceLimitAndVolumeGroup.volumeGroup: Incoming alias flags0.volumeGroup (bits17-21) is compared with exact g_snd+0x158. If unequal, this gate allows. If equal, any active voice whose alias has the same volumeGroup causes rejection; if none exists, it allows.
